title: (a) The all-types fixture and test payload carry the prior answer {question_id: quality, choice: yes}, but quality's choices are pass and fa
description: (a) The all-types fixture and test payload carry the prior answer {question_id: quality, choice: yes}, but quality's choices are pass and fail. sc-jev-check's `validate_state` would refuse that state as 'not in the question'. (b) The `CanonicalJudgePayload::from_bytes` doc says the error never names a payload byte outside a question id, but it formats the raw serde error (`canonical payload is invalid: {error}`). For type mismatches serde_json echoes the offending value (for example `invalid type: string "..."`).
